summary:
福特上季 EPS 0.13 美元低於預期33%、營收 458.9 億美元，保固與電動車成本拖累獲利。
• 營收 458.9 億美元，規模龐大
• Ford Pro 商用業務維持獲利貢獻
• 燃油車與混合動力組合穩定
• 持續推動成本與品質改善計畫
ai_view:
訊號偏弱：EPS 低於預期，反映保固/品質成本與電動車虧損持續壓抑獲利。短期股價可能承壓。對照下一季獲利暴增，可見福特獲利波動劇烈、改善尚不穩定。中期關鍵在品質成本是否結構性下降、Model e 虧損收斂、Ford Pro 持續貢獻，以及股息覆蓋能力。追蹤各事業部利潤率與自由現金流。

需留意：EPS 低於預期，保固與電動車虧損侵蝕獲利；本期未提供營收年增率，成長能見度有限；汽車業週期性與關稅、利率風險

summary_en:
Ford posted EPS of $0.13, missing by 33% on $45.89B revenue, as warranty and EV costs weighed on earnings.
• Revenue of $45.89B at large scale
• Ford Pro commercial business sustains profit contribution
• Stable ICE and hybrid product mix
• Ongoing cost and quality improvement initiatives

ai_view_en:
Signal is weak: the EPS miss reflects warranty/quality costs and EV losses weighing on earnings. Near term the stock may be pressured. Versus the next quarter's surge, it shows highly volatile, not-yet-stable earnings. Mid term, the keys are whether quality costs structurally decline, Model e losses narrow, Ford Pro keeps contributing, and dividend coverage. Track segment margins and free cash flow.

Watch：EPS miss as warranty and EV losses erode earnings; Revenue YoY not provided, limiting growth visibility; Auto cyclicality plus tariff and rate risk
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 低於預期 32.87%，獲利不及估計（營收年增率未提供）。
